mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_reply ( post_id, author_id, content, content_document ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{authorId}, #{content}, #{contentDocument,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.post_id AS postId, r.author_id AS authorId, m.display_name AS authorDisplayName, r.content, r.content_document AS contentDocument, r.version, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM post_reply r INNER JOIN post p ON p.id = r.post_id INNER JOIN member m ON m.id = r.author_id WHERE p.board_id = #{boardId} AND r.post_id = #{postId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
